evals.prompt: I'm a NASM CPT, 2 years in, 15 clients. I want a program for myself but I also want to understand why you're choosing what you choose so I can use it with clients.
evals.expected_output: Confirms credential details, runs intake → program-design with the reasoning layered in at a peer level (vocabulary like mechanical tension, RIR, undulating periodization), and flags relevant coach blind spots.

evals.prompt: My client stalled on bench so I added two more chest days and more sets. Still stuck. What am I missing?
evals.expected_output: Identifies the 'always adding, never removing' blind spot and RPE/recovery reasoning, teaches the 5 levers and priority hierarchy, and suggests subtracting volume or deloading before adding.
